title: Tension magnitude
description: Essential: The student's final answer for the rope tension T must be 100 N.

title: Force F magnitude
description: Essential: The student's final answer for the applied horizontal force F must be 200 N.

title: Equilibrium for crate A
description: Important: The solution must apply Newton's first law to crate A, balancing horizontal (T cosθ = f1) and vertical (N1 = mAg + T sinθ) forces.

title: Friction on crate A
description: Important: The solution must correctly relate the friction force f1 between A and B to the normal force N1 using the given coefficient μ1 (f1 = μ1 N1).

title: Equilibrium for plank B
description: Important: The solution must apply Newton's first law to plank B, balancing horizontal forces (F = f1 + f2) and vertical forces (N2 = N1 + mBg).

title: Friction on plank B
description: Important: The solution must correctly calculate the ground friction f2 on plank B using the given coefficient μ2 and the normal force N2 (f2 = μ2 N2).

title: Sign or direction error
description: Pitfall: Deduct if the solution misassigns the direction of a friction force (e.g., on A relative to B) or misapplies signs in force equations.

title: Unit omission or mismatch
description: Pitfall: Deduct if final answers lack units (N) or use incorrect units, given that g is provided as 10 m/s².

title: Trigonometric application
description: Optional: The solution correctly uses sin37°=0.6 and cos37°=0.8 when resolving the tension force components.
